_comment: CANONICAL SOURCE for the DRS overlay visual language. Python reads this file directly (core/overlay_tokens.py); the JavaScript twin (dashboard/electron/renderer/overlay/tokens.js) embeds the same values and tests/test_overlay_tokens.py fails if the two diverge. Renderers request a ROLE, never a colour: the role carries meaning, and the meaning is what must not drift.

path.predicted.means: Positions the model inferred. Never drawn in the measured colour.

path.transition.means: Where observation stops and inference begins. DERIVED from the last measured point, never stored — a stored copy drifts away from the path it labels.

mark.detected.means: A real image-space detection with no calibrated measurement behind it. Outlined, never filled: a fill hides the pixels the umpire is judging.

guide.schematic.means: Assumed geometry, not an observation. Always accompanied by the words 'calibrate to measure'.

geometry.reference.means: Real pitch geometry projected from a calibrated camera (crease, stump line).

state.unobserved.means: The system could not look. Neutral grey — never the adverse colour, never the safe colour.

status.adverse.means: A resolved outcome against the batter.

status.safe.means: A resolved outcome in the batter's favour.

casing.means: Dark stroke under every overlay line. MANDATORY: measured on real footage, no candidate colour reaches 3:1 luminance contrast against sunlit grass, so the casing carries luminance and the hue carries identity.

label.means: Names a drawn element on the frame.

qualifier.means: Prose that explains a state ('schematic — calibrate to measure'). The only non-uppercase text on a frame, because it is read as a sentence.

measurement.means: A calibrated number. Value and unit together, never a bare number. White by default; tinted by outcome only when it resolves the decision.

frame.counter.means: Which frame is on screen. Same corner on every review type.

legend.means: The standing three-symbol key (measured / guide / detected). Same corner on every review type, so the vocabulary teaches itself.
